notes.title: Crystal Story II Feb 14 Update
notes.notes:
Happy Valentines Day! Crystal Story II is now version 2.1.

http://i.imgur.com/zrtdy6Y.jpg

Change Log:

Crystal Story II

"Giant Lotus" second form now shows its HP bar correctly.
Generic Quest and Proof of Might achievements should now properly unlock
Fixed "Mercenary Defense" Goblin getting stuck behind trees
Fixed dialogue typo (Bengal cutscene, Spiderking)
Added Hard Mode Bosses on the arena for fun
Boss music added to Arena bosses
Changed "Scribbled Card" description


Crystal Story

Added a quit button on the title screen and the main menu
Fixed "Business" typo (Intro cutscene)
FIXED PHOEBE LOWER CASE DIALOGUE (Intro cutscene)
Fixed "It's" typo (Giant enemy crab cutscene)
